ING-036-car-backseat-sunbeam.why: Single central Kelly plate with ring-style turn lock, staples both sides, one matching belt, braided top edge, creased glossy leather; cleanest closure of the three, believable cabin light. v1/v2 also pass truth but v3 hardware is closest to gallery.

ING-040-home-island-flowers.why: Correct single-plate cognac closure with lower receiver plate and both staples, two rolled handles, braided edging, most convincing leather patina; lived-in kitchen with no readable text. v1/v3 body texture reads slightly embossed-print.

ING-043-home-entry-floor.why: Single central plate plus small band plate, one belt through staples, braided edge, two handles; moody window light on worn parquet reads most photoreal. v1 flatter and more staged, v3 fine but weaker light.

ING-049-home-radiator-window.why: Correct single central plate closure with turn toggle and lower plate, two clearly separate rolled handles, braided stitching, most natural creased leather and sun; v1/v2 pass truth but texture reads more etched.

ING-052-home-kitchen-table-paper.why: Only variant without readable newsprint: v2 shows 'Weekend / Brexit vote' headline and v3 shows 'That wild tangle' = readable-text FAIL. v1 closure is correct single central plate, paper stays illegible.

ING-054-open-overhead-counter.why: Open truth complete: gaping mouth, both handles fall outward, belts hang loose with plate tips, unlined caramel suede interior, no lining/zipper/tag. v1 shows no handles anywhere; v2 has an invented brass ring-buckle at bottom right.

ING-058-open-sofa-corner.why: Both handles flop outward, straps dangle with their plate tips, turret receiver on band, tan suede interior unlined, braided flap edge; v1 has a long thin strap reading as a shoulder strap and no visible handles, v2 hides the handles.

ING-062-pack-book.why: Natural five-finger hand mid-motion, plain book, caramel suede interior visible and unlined, both handles drooping through the shaped front cutouts, single-plate hardware family; v2 good but interior hidden and flap fold tangled, v3 slumped with clustered hardware.

ING-065-pack-scarf.why: Cleanest open truth: hand natural, unlined tan suede interior, braided edge, strap tips with their gold plates hanging loose, turret receiver on band; v2 has a heart-shaped hole punched mid-band and busier keeper hardware, v3 hardware clusters oddly.

ING-068-pack-baguette.why: Both hands natural with five fingers, unlined tan suede interior, single receiver plate on band with strap tip beside it, handle drooping forward, flour-dusted counter very photoreal; v2 flap construction jumbled with mid-panel heart cutouts, v3 has doubled side-by-side clasp plates plus a third dangling plate = invented hardware.
